sketches.mechanism: EmptyCase over the uninhabited Void type; a function from Void can return any type because no caller can ever supply a value.
sketches.resonance: From an impossible witness, every future is type-correct, but none can be reached.

sketches.mechanism: A return in a finally block overrides and discards a prior return from the try block.
sketches.resonance: The last gesture rewrites the whole intention, leaving the earlier promise unreachable.

sketches.mechanism: A constrained subtype performs a range check on assignment and raises Constraint_Error when a value exceeds its declared bounds.
sketches.resonance: A life defined as exactly one pulse cannot survive the attempt to become two.
